_comment: Attributes which the OpenMS 3.6 CTDs are missing, applied to the CTD
snapshot before anything reads it (aux/strip_output_dirs.py's neighbour in
test-data.sh, i.e. before get_tests.py and CTDConverter).  Keys are CTD
<ITEM name=...> paths, values the attributes to set.
DecoyDatabase: -NeighborSearch:out_neighbor/-out_relevant are FASTA files,
but the CTD declares no supported_formats, so CTDConverter falls back to
'txt' and OpenMS refuses the output at run time:
Invalid parameter: ... Unable to write file
('NeighborSearch_out_neighbor/output.txt'): invalid file extension;
expected 'fasta'
OpenSwathWorkflow: -Calibration:rt_norm (and -Calibration:files:linear_irt_file)
name an RT normalization file, but upstream types them as 'string'.  A
string parameter is passed through to the command line as given, so the
generated test hands OpenMS a bare file name that Galaxy never staged:
Error: File not found (the file 'OpenSwathWorkflow_1_input.trafoXML'
could not be found)
Declaring them input-file makes them data inputs, which the wrapper copies
into the job directory like every other fixture.  linear_irt_file stays
text: upstream passes a *space separated list* of iRT files to it (see
TOPP_OpenSwathWorkflow_27), which a single data input cannot express, so
get_tests.py skips those tests instead (text_params_with_files()).
